title: Benchmarking and Revisiting Code Generation Assessment: A Mutation-Based Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Applying 10 mutation strategies (such as typo simulation, synonym substitution, LLM paraphrasing, and example insertion/removal) to standard code generation prompts and measuring Correctness Variability (CV) and Mutation Bias (MB) to quantify how single-prompt benchmarks skew the performance assessment of Code Large Language Models.
